messages:
maria (product): Idea to reduce friction during model rollouts: offer a tenant-level opt-in called "auto-pin-renew" + a migration credit bundle that auto-applies when we force-deprecate a pinned model. Want feedback on safety gates and GTM.

dan (eng): server-side toggle per-tenant makes sense. Need clarity: does auto-pin-renew automatically swap pinned model to new default or just extend pin?

maria (product): it should attempt to swap to the recommended model when we schedule a catalog transition. If the swap fails acceptance checks, we keep the original pin. No silent surprises.

lee (eng-ml): acceptance checks need to be explicit. Proposal: compare new vs pinned over two dimensions: 1) eval quality (AUC/accuracy/F1 depending on task) >= 97% of baseline, 2) median P50 latency <= 1.25x baseline. If both pass -> auto-swap allowed. Otherwise require manual acceptance.

alex (support): need pre-swap artifacts in console so CS can preview differences: a diff view + 5 example model outputs for tenant traffic samples. Also recommend an escape hatch: customers can opt-out per-swap in the modal.

nina (sales): migration credit sounds attractive for enterprise renewals. Suggest tiers: SMB -> 1 month free reroute; Mid -> 2 months; Enterprise -> custom credit (default $5k or 3mo). Eligibility rule: accounts > $50k ARR get auto-enroll unless they opt-out at contract stage.

maria (product): comms plan: 1) console banner + modal with sample outputs, 2) billing contact email + AE note, 3) webhook + audit log entry for tenants that want programmatic hooks.

deploybot: created issue INF-4921: auto-pin-renew runbook checklist https://internal.redwood/infra/INF-4921

dan (eng): implementation notes: need per-tenant KV cache invalidation and safe rollback rails. Also telemetry capture for before/after quality sampling (short TTL). Estimate 2 weeks if minimal telemetry, 3.5 weeks if we store samples for 7 days.

lee (eng-ml): add semantic regressions to checks. Lightweight LM-based hallucination score should not increase >1.4x. We can compute on the eval subset quickly. Config example: 
```
pin_policy: auto_pin_renew
acceptance_criteria: [
  {metric: "quality_ratio", min: 0.97},
  {metric: "latency_multiplier", max: 1.25},
  {metric: "hallucination_ratio", max: 1.4}
]
migration_credit: {type: "tiered", tiers: ["1mo","2mo","custom"]}
```

alex (support): also require runbook SLAs: if >5 P1 tickets within 2 hours of swap, open emergency rollback and notify ops/product/sales. We'll prepare canned replies and an FAQ template.

nina (sales): can we auto-apply migration credits for long-standing contracts (>6mo) so AEs don't have to negotiate each time? Helps closing.

maria (product): yeah we can. We'll publish eligibility rules in pricing docs. Action items: Dan -> infra and rollback APIs. Lee -> define eval sets and hallucination metric; make quick-run suite (<5 min). Alex -> support runbook + CS training. Nina -> credit tiers and contract language. I'll write PRD and mockups.

dan (eng): ack. I'll add a dedicated canary toggle per deployment pool and a telemetry flag. Also an emergency opt-out endpoint for customers.

lee (eng-ml): I'll add a smoke harness and fast-turn eval pipeline for these swaps. Plan: run on sample tenant inputs and the shared eval sets.

alex (support): scheduling a 30-min CS pre-canary training. Will post link to materials here when ready.

nina (sales): request: need PRD by Wed EOD to review before GTM sync Thu.

maria (product): aiming for Wed EOD PRD. I'll post the draft and tag owners for review. Keep updates to short sentences here. :sparkles:
